title: The Goal Was Antarctica, Not the Gym
hook: The Goal Was Antarctica, Not the Gym
caption:
The Goal Was Antarctica, Not the Gym

Jenice wasn't training because she wanted to become someone who was really good at working out.

She was training because she wanted to go to Antarctica.

And she wanted to experience the trip—not simply get there.

She was afraid she wouldn't be able to handle the land excursions through the snow, mountains, and hills. 

That's a very different reason to get stronger.

The goal wasn't a heavier weight in the gym.

It was being able to step off the ship and participate in the experiences she'd traveled all that way to have.
